title: Genealogical document: record
description: One entry of a book, as transcribed: a birth, a marriage, a death, a household, a letter's paragraph. It lives in a part of the book. Genealogical Document Spec 1.x. SPEC.md lists the rules a schema cannot express.

id.description: Identifier of the record: unique within the book, given once, never changed and never given to another record. Opaque. Software that creates a record generates 12 random characters.

type.description: What the entry records: birth, marriage, death, other, or another word a collection needs. Left out when no type fits (a household of a confession list).

year.description: Year of the entry. Must lie within the years of its part when the part gives them, otherwise within the book's yearFrom–yearTo. Left out when it is not known.

no.description: Entry number, as written in the source. Left out when the source has none.

date.description: Date text, as written in the source. Left out when the source has none.

scans.description: Ids of the scans the entry appears on, in reading order. What an id is, the book's scanSource says. Empty when there is no scan.

fields.description: What the entry says, keyed by the keys its part declares in `fields`. Plain text. Only declared keys; the part's first field must be filled; any other is left out when empty.
